[[File:NightsisterFlail-Monster.png|thumb|250px|[[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress's]] Night Sister Flail]]
A '''flail''' was a weapon that had a weighted ball or blade attached to one end of a rope or a chain. They were difficult to master, but those that could master this weapon were able to inflict injuries to enemies at close range. The [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]] sometimes used a spiked flail.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
